entries.title: Hosea 3:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The Lord's intended future kindness to Israel, not withstanding their wickedness, illustrated by the emblem of Hosea's conduct towards his adulterous wife. 4 The desolation of Israel before their restoration.

Go yet. 1:2,3 friend. Jer 3:1,20; *marg: Mt 26:50 according. 11:8; De 7:6,7; Jud 10:16; 2Ki 13:23; Ne 9:18,19,31; Ps 106:43-46 Jer 3:1-4,12-14; 31:20; Mic 7:18-20; Zec 1:16; Lu 1:54,55 look. Ps 123:2; Isa 17:7,8; 45:22; Mic 7:7 love flagons. 4:11; 7:5; 9:1,2; Ex 32:6; Jud 9:27; Am 2:8; 6:6; 1Co 10:7,21; 1Pe 4:3 wine. Heb. grapes.

entries.title: Hosea 3:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I bought. Ge 31:41; 34:12; Ex 22:17; 1Sa 18:25 an homer. Le 27:16; Isa 5:10; Eze 45:11 half homer. Heb. lethech.

entries.title: Hosea 3:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: without a king. 10:3; Ge 49:10; Jer 15:4,5; Joh 19:15 without a sacrifice. 2Ch 15:2; Da 8:11-13; 9:27; 12:11; Mt 24:1,2; Lu 21:24; Ac 6:13,14 Heb 10:26 an image. Heb. a standing, or statue, or pillar. Isa 19:19,20 ephod. Ex 28:4; Le 8:7; Jud 8:27; 17:5; 1Sa 2:18; 14:3; 21:9; 22:18; 23:6,9 1Sa 30:7; 2Sa 6:14 without teraphim.
